en.NAME: REVIEW API BASE URL
en.DESCRIPTION: Absolute https origin of the Core deployment with no path, for example https://dev-1.servicewand.com. Any other value is discarded and the page reports that it is not set up. The link token is read only from the #token= fragment of the address the client opens; no token, account or customer value is configured here.
